changelog: One customer can now have many people, each with their own mobile number. A company like Tata gives work through several staff — open the company and you see every job it ever gave, whoever phoned it in.
New Order asks for the Contact Person next to the mobile number. Type a known number and it fills in the company and the person by itself.

A number nobody recognises offers two ways forward: attach it to a customer you already have (start typing the name), or add a brand new one. So a second number for the same firm never creates a second account.
The customer screen lists everyone in the account with their numbers, and every order shows Given by — which person it came from.
Add, rename, remove people and set the main number from the customer's Edit screen. A number can only ever belong to one person, and a customer always keeps at least one number.
City has been removed from the customer and order screens. Address stays.
